newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Kelon plans China plant.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Kelon plans China plant.

text.p: Guangdong Kelon Electrical Holdings Co Ltd said on Friday it signed a letter of intent with a Chinese company to jointly manufacture chlorofluorocarbon-free energy-saving refrigerators in Chengdu in China's Sichuan province.

Guangdong Kelon and its wholly-owned unit Pearl River Electrical Refrigerator Co Ltd would hold a total of 70 percent of the venture, which would have a total investment of 240 million yuan, it said in a statment.
The company said the venture would become its first factory outside Guangdong province.
Guangdong Kelon believed the venture would help the company to expand into the central and western China market.
The factory has a designed production capacity of about 500,000 refrigerators a year, the company added. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
